question: If the full Lord has no real divisions, why speak of above, middle, and end?
premises: The full Lord has no real arrangement of above, beginning, middle, or end.
Such distinctions serve both students and teachers.
inference: Spatial divisions are pedagogical constructs, not ultimate realities in the full Lord.
plain_english: For the full Lord there is no real arrangement of above, beginning, middle, or end; nevertheless, such distinctions are used for the sake of those who must understand and for the one who teaches.
